name: playgroup
note: FIVE PLAYERS, the size of the table at Oliver's -- edgar-vampires 002 and 004, goblin-storm 002 and ur-dragon 003 are all 'five-player pod: Sean, Oliver, Tom, Alex, Ryan'. The seats are the archetypes those games record; the mapping from seat to person is approximate and deliberately so, per the pilot: 'the exact pod players is less important than just having calibrated teams playing against each other'. Two archetypes come from the log verbatim and two from the pilot, for decks the log names only by colour and mechanic. This table has NEVER BEEN PLAYED in simulation, so it has no null -- `pods playgroup --calibration` after some games.

seats.note: Tom, named in goblin-storm 002 and edgar-vampires 004.
Tom's other deck: 'one of his blue-black decks' (edgar 001), discard per the pilot. Nekusar is Grixis rather than UB and is the archetype's clearest expression.
Alex: 'came in with his fight deck and took out some vampires' (edgar 004). Neyith triggers on every fight, so the mechanic IS the commander.
